name: a macro sphere holds under a figure caption
looks: A glass sphere filled with fine textured grains sits centred and nearly still against a soft-focus dark background of large out-of-focus circles, lit from one side, with a small italic figure caption beneath it like a page from a textbook.
build: cinematic-atmosphere-hold: a near-static camera, a shallow-depth background of blurred circular shapes drifting faintly, one warm rim light, a fine grain pass over the whole frame; the caption types on in a small italic serif with a figure-number prefix.
sound: A low, quiet ambient tone, almost silent.
prompt: Hold a near-still macro shot of a small textured object in a glass or transparent vessel, lit from one side against a soft blurred background, with a small italic figure caption typing on beneath it like a textbook illustration. Use it to open on craft and material rather than on the product's interface.
